title: DLUSD stablecoin wallet launches in Argentina
description: Deel launched its stablecoin wallet using DLUSD on 2026-06-03, with Bridge Open Issuance minting the custom stablecoin and Tempo providing settlement. Deel later reported the wallet live in more than 80 countries.
notes: Launch date comes from Stripe's contemporaneous announcement. Later Deel material confirms broader live rollout rather than a planned-only launch.
